prose.subject: Invoice INV-84756 - Alder Supply
prose.body:
Dear Eastgate Clinics Accounts Payable,

Please find attached invoice INV-84756 for services rendered in the current billing cycle. The total amount due is 9033.03 USDC.

Line Items:
1. Medical Gantry Maintenance (June): 4500.00 USDC
2. Sterilization Unit Parts: 2100.03 USDC
3. Technical Support & Labor: 2433.00 USDC

Payment is requested within 30 days of the issue date. As per our standard agreement, please remit funds to our designated receiving address: 0x6fbbe7956c8240a8c83057f9a5362502b75eaa13.

If you have any questions regarding this invoice or require a detailed breakdown of the labor hours, please contact our billing department at billing@alder-supply.example. Kindly include the invoice number INV-84756 in your communication to ensure quick processing.

Thank you for your continued business with Alder Supply.

Best regards,
Mara Vance
Senior Accountant
Alder Supply Co.
